name: Hollowcrown Dragon - Adult
description: Adult Hollowcrown is a evil-leaning eclipsed intelligent true dragon with blackened gold scales and a broken halo. It seeks to compel obedience from subjects who no longer exist. At this age it is a commanding force in its territory.

attacks.name: Crowned Talons
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 3 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Royal Brand
abilities.description: The dragon knows the direction of every creature branded by its breath within Far range.

abilities.name: Sovereign Flame
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 18. On a failure, take 3d8+6 magic damage and the target is branded with a visible crown until the end of the scene. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Kneel
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. Choose one branded creature within Far range. It must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or become Restrained until it escapes with a successful Presence Roll or the dragon is defeated.

abilities.name: Defiance Burns
abilities.description: When a branded creature within Far range openly defies a spoken command, mark a Stress to make it mark 1 Stress.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
